name: PARK SEUNGJUN
intro: I build interfaces where machines are encountered not only as tools, but as bodies that hold time, labor, ritual, and care.
about: My practice moves between robotic installation, moving image, artificial intelligence, and Korean metal inlay. I am interested in the moment a technical system becomes a relationship—and in how an interface can make that change perceptible.
availability: Selected works, research notes, and works in progress.
